trial_court: Family Court cum V Additional District Judge at Visakhapatnam (FCOP No. 1550 / 2024)
case_name: Smt Malipeddi Uma vs Sri Malipeddi Srinivasa Rao
facts_of_case: Petitioner is legally wedded wife of respondent seeking withdrawal of FCOP and transfer to another court for trial.

legal_principles.principle: Service held sufficient when no representation is made on behalf of the respondent.
legal_principles.held: Though registered notice sent to the respondent and the same was served on him, none appeared for the respondent. Therefore, 'service held sufficient'.

legal_principles.principle: A petitioner seeking withdrawal of a case and transfer to another court must demonstrate sufficient reason.
legal_principles.held: The material on record prima facie goes to shows that, in view of the matrimonial disputes, the petitioner/wife has been residing separately along with her children in her parents' house at Vizianagaram...

outcome.final_order: 'Service held sufficient'. Petition under Section 24 of the C.P.C. allowed, FCOP No. 1550 / 2024 withdrawn and transferred to Judge, Family Court, Vizianagaram.

use_for_drafting: drafting a petition for stay of proceedings in a family court
advising on the transfer of a case from one family court to another
assisting with a matrimonial dispute involving a Hindu couple
